subject: SIG / CAIQ: request for change-manifest, CI proof and reviewer mapping
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@assessments.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.example.com>
Cc: security-team@argentipay.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG / CAIQ artifact ask — change history, CI traces, reviewer mapping

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for the quick intake call this morning. For the SIG/CAIQ assessor bundle we need the following artifacts scoped to ArgentiPay's production-relevant services (the assessor will sample across a 12-month window):

- A chronologically-ordered change manifest (change events for releases, rollbacks, emergency patches) with author and approver mapping.
- Representative CI/CD run logs for builds that reached production (sanitized where necessary).
- A small sample of PRs with code-review comments (redact secrets/identifiers) that show reviewer roles and approval flow.
- Short notes on how ephemeral credentials are handled in the pipeline and any gating controls.

Please let me know if you can provide these as CSVs/log snippets and an expected delivery date. If anything needs to be redacted we can accept a sanitized package plus a signed attestation confirming authenticity.

Target for assessor review is 2026-04-02 — is that feasible for a preliminary package?

Best,
Nora
Nora Patel
Senior Assessor, SecureAssess
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.example.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@assessments.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.example.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ artifact ask — change history, CI traces, reviewer mapping

Hi Nora — thanks for the clear list. Quick notes:

- We can produce a change manifest covering 2025-03 through 2026-03 with metadata: change_id, change_type, author, approver, deploy_window, rollback_flag.
- CI/CD logs: we'll include sanitized build logs and a short explanation of our ephemeral credential handling.
- PR samples: we can provide three PRs from different services (core-inference, runtime-orch, control-plane) with reviewer roles and timestamps; PII/UUIDs will be redacted.
- Attestation: we can provide a signed attestation from our InfoSec lead if the assessor needs a statement of authenticity for redacted artifacts.

Irene, Jordan — looping you in for artifact collection and to confirm redaction approach. Nora, can you confirm whether the assessor team prefers CSV or spreadsheet for the manifest? Also confirming the 2026-04-02 target — we should be able to deliver a preliminary bundle by 2026-03-30.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Park
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.example.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.example.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ artifact ask — change history, CI traces, reviewer mapping

Thanks Ethan — I'll assemble the package. Plan:

1) Change manifest: export from our release ledger (internal tool) as CSV. Columns: change_id, service, change_type (release/hotfix/rollback), author, approver, deploy_ts, rollback_ts (if any), ticket_ref, notes. I will remove internal ticket URLs and replace them with short ticket IDs.

2) CI logs: include one full build log (sanitized) and two condensed snippets that show gating failures/approvals. I will scrub any ephemeral token strings and redact IPs.

3) PR review sample: provide three PRs with reviewer names (role only: reviewer/team-lead/approver) and inline comments. The sample will be exported to JSON and then redacted to remove system UUIDs and internal run IDs.

4) Controls write-up: a 1-page summary describing how we gate production deploys (branch protection, required approvals, CI gating policies, ephemeral runner usage).

Attachments I'll drop to the shared drive for the assessor and include a signed attestation PDF that Jordan will approve. Initial attachments (stubs attached to internal mail): change-manifest-2023-2025.csv, ci-run-20250315-argon-build.log, pr-review-sample-sanitized.json.

Delivery ETA: 2026-03-29 (to give engineering time for redaction).

Irene
Irene Choi
Dir., Applied Security | Redwood Inference
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@assessments.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.example.com>
Cc: security-team@argentipay.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ artifact ask — change history, CI traces, reviewer mapping

Thanks, Irene and team — that plan looks good. A couple of clarifications from the assessor side:

- CSV is preferred for the manifest (easier to ingest).
- For PR samples, please include the reviewer role mapping (e.g., reviewer: service-owner, approver: release-manager). Role labels are sufficient — we do not need full org charts.
- For the CI logs, sanitize secrets and token fragments; if you are removing identifiable trace IDs please provide a short mapping file describing what was redacted (e.g., "replaced build UUIDs with BUILD-001/BUILD-002"). That mapping can be redacted itself in delivery and retained by Redwood if you prefer, but the assessor needs to understand the scope of redaction.

Finally, we do require a short signed attestation that the redactions did not alter the sequence of events (no edits to timestamps or who approved). We can accept a PDF signed in DocuSign. If you can provide the attestation by 2026-03-30 that will work for our sampling schedule.

Nora
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ artifact ask — change history, CI traces, reviewer mapping

Ethan/Marissa — good plan from Irene. Operational notes:

- Marissa — please generate the change-manifest CSV export scoped to 2025-03-01 through 2026-03-01 and place in the secure Drive path: https://drive.redwood.example.com/secure/ArgentiPay/SIG_2026/ (use redwood-assessors group ACL).
- Marissa — include the sanitized ci-run-20250315-argon-build.log and pr-review-sample-sanitized.json there as well.
- I've attached an attestation draft (attestation-draft-ethic-sign.pdf). Ethan — please route this to Legal/InfoSec for signature in DocuSign and send Nora the DocuSign link once signed.

I'll own the reviewer-role mapping note and provide a 1-page controls summary. Aim to have the drive folder populated and DocuSign in flight by 2026-03-29.

Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Security Assurance | Redwood Inference
